title: 18F-Labeled Picolinamide PET Imaging of Melanoma Diagnosis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the dosimetric properties of the positron emission tomography (PET) imaging probe 18F labeled Picolinamide (18F-P3BZA) and preliminarily evaluate its diagnosis value in melanoma patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients with melanoma: diagnosed by pathology and ready for surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients with melanoma: refuse or cannot endure surgery
* pregnant women
